questions.question: The current age of Savan is four times the age of Akshan. 10 years from now, Savan’s age will be twice the age of Akshan. What is Savan’s current age?
questions.solution:
Let Current age of Akshan = X

Current age of Savan = 4X

Age of akshan after 10 years = X + 10

Age of Savan after 10 years = 4X + 10

As given in question,

4X + 10 = 2(X + 10)

4X + 10 = 2X + 20

X = 5 and 4X = 20

Hence age of savan is 20 years .

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All fields are farm-houses.

Some fields are gardens.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some farm-houses are fields.

II. Some gardens are fields.

III. Some farm-houses are gardens.

options.text: All the conclusions, I, II and III,
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Either conclusion I or III follows.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faa726e7403111d0e42f77d152dff8ef52632fdde7a026a7413586df09352f89.png] 

Some farm-houses are fields → True.

Some gardens are fields → True.

Some farm-houses are gardens → True.

Hence all conclusions follow.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Which number will be on the face opposite to the one having 4?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c69c0e7462ee39a08eb1135946d0196c3710c951a0a22aaba40e7b6d9711a795.png]
questions.solution:
From given 1st cube diagram we know that 1 and 3 are adjacent to 6.

From 2ⁿd cube we know that 2 and 5 are adjacent to 6.

Only one remaining number is 4 and that will be opposite to 6.

Hence 6 will be on face opposite to the one having 4.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

40 + 10 ÷ 2 × 8 – 17 = 17
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and –

40 - 10 ÷ 2 + 8 + 17 = 40 - 5 × 8 + 17

**40 - 40 + 17 = 17**

Interchanging ÷ and ×

40 + 10 times 2 div 8 + 17 = 40 + (5)/(2) + 17 ne 17

Interchanging × and +

40 × 10 ÷ 2 + 8 - 17 = 40 × 5 + 8 - 17

200 + 8 - 17 ≠ 17

Interchanging ÷ and –

40 + 10 - 2 times 8 div 17 = 40 + 10 - frac{{2 times 8}}{{17}}

50 - frac{{16}}{{17}} ne 17

Hence by interchanging + and – we get the correct equation.
